continuation_context.root_cause: The NF encoding commits to fixed-arity evaluation. Rabinovich's proof operates on variable-arity interval formulas where the number of witnesses decreases at each induction step. The Lean code's depth-first NF decomposition creates a depth gap that cannot be bridged without simultaneously handling all arities — which the current architecture doesn't support cleanly.
